entry.title: I added a small gate to the Gated DeltaNet layers of Qwen3.5 and trained it with GRPO under a length penalty.
entry.content: I added a small gate to the Gated DeltaNet layers of Qwen3.5 and trained it with GRPO under a length penalty. On Qwen3.5-4B it reasons 48% shorter than LoRA on MATH-500, and anytime accuracy goes from 0.786 to 0.852. A LoRA with about the same parameter count barely moves. The gate sits on beta, the per-token write strength. One matrix per layer, zero init, so it starts as a no-op. It started as a negative eigenvalue experiment. The negative range turned out not to matter. The gate did. entry.title: VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction
entry.content: Visual agents must turn video observations into timely decisions to track progress and choose what to do next. Building on the emerging System One paradigm, we introduce VideoJev, a family of models that cast video understanding and interaction as structured decision tasks. We adapt pretrained multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by replacing autoregressive answer decoding with a shared head that scores temporal intervals and textual options against video evidence. These scores yield event spans or answer choices, unifying temporal grounding and multiple-choice video question answering. This combines the semantic flexibility of MLLMs with efficient decisions that agents can use directly.

entry.content: The cost of a judging gate is usually quoted as a number. This puts it on a Tetris board.
